<function name="SetConstraintRadius" parent="CMoveData" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the radius that constrains the players movement.

Works with conjunction of:
* <page>CMoveData:SetConstraintWidth</page>
* <page>CMoveData:SetConstraintSpeedScale</page>
* <page>CMoveData:SetConstraintCenter</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="radius" type="number">The new constraint radius</arg>
	</args>
</function>
